SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch Station.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 7939 Date May 22, 1940.）

Subject William Charles Smith - Letter from H.B.M. Consulate-General

Made by. D.S.I. Logan. Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford.

With reference to attached letter dated
11.5.40, from the Passport & Registration Office,
British Consulate-General in reference to William
Charles Smith, a photograph of this individual was
obtained and shown to the Chinese watchman on duty
in Lane 1376, Yu Yuen Road, who stated that he
recognized it as being that of a man who lives with
a Chinese girl in House 18 of Lane 1376 and
not House 36, as stated in Special Branch report
dated 29.4.40. According to the watchman,
Smith is a frequent visitor at House 36 but has
not been seen in the alleyway for about a fortnight.
Several of the houses in Lane 1376 are occupied
by Chinese girls who are kept by foreigners. A
visit was paid to House 18, Lane 1376, by D.S.I.
Logan on 16.5.40, when a Korean woman who resides
there was questioned but she refused to give any
information about the occupants. According to
the Chinese watchman in the Lane, this woman is
also kept by a foreigner who frequently visits the
house. Enquiries at House 36, by D.S.I. Logan
also met with a refusal to give any information
concerning the occupants.
It would appear certain that Smith has

事由 威廉·查尔斯·史密斯（William Charles Smith）——英国驻沪总领事馆来函

制作人：副督察长洛根（Logan）。转呈人：督察克劳福德（Crawford）。

关于随附的1940年5月11日英国驻沪总领事馆护照与注册办公室有关威廉·查尔斯·史密斯的来信，已获取该人的照片，并出示给在愚园路1376弄值勤的中国更夫，该更夫称认出照片中的人是住在愚园路1376弄18号的一名男子，并与一名中国女子同居，而非1940年4月29日特别股报告中所称的36号。据该更夫称，史密斯是36号的常客，但已有约两周未在弄堂内出现。1376弄内的几处房屋住有被外国人包养的中国女子。1940年5月16日，副督察长洛根前往愚园路1376弄18号探访，询问了居住在那里的一名朝鲜妇女，但她拒绝提供关于住户的任何信息。据弄堂内的中国更夫称，这名妇女也被一名经常来访的外国人包养。副督察长洛根在36号的查询也遭到了拒绝，对方不愿提供关于住户的任何信息。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL.
P.O. BOX 259.
SHANGHAI.
11th May, 1940.

Dear Mr. Yorke,

Your will doubtless remember that you
kindly gave me the address of one William Charles Smith
(see your letter D 9988 of the 29th April).

I have written twice to ask him to call
and my last letter of May 2nd, has been returned undelivered
(see the accompanying envelope).

I wonder whether you would be so good
as to let me know whether Smith is still at this address.
Once again many thanks for your assistance.

Yours sincerely,

（批：* Returned.
23/5/40）

R.W. Yorke, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date April 29, 1940.

Subject. William Charles Smith (British) - Letter from H.B.M. Consulate-
General enquiring whereabouts of.

Made by. D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford

With reference to the attached letter,
dated April 12, 1940, from the Passport and
Registration Office, British Consulate-General,
enquiring the whereabouts of William Charles
Smith (British), aged 53, former employee of the
Shanghai River Police, enquiries revealed that
this person resides with a Chinese dancing girl
in an upstairs back room of House 36, Lane 1376,
Yu Yuen Road. Smith leaves the house every night
at 11 p.m., together with the dancing girl and
returns at 4 or 5 a.m. the next morning. He is
stated to be connected in some way with the
gambling dens in the Western District but in what
capacity is unknown. Mr. Vivian Lenoise, referred
to in Mr. Cox's letter, was unable to give any
useful information concerning Smith's whereabouts
and it was with considerable difficulty that he
was located, hence the delay in submitting this
report.

D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 1，特别股
报告
日期 1940年4月29日。

事由：威廉·查尔斯·史密斯（英籍）——英国驻沪总领事馆来函查询其下落。

制作人：副督察长洛根 转呈人：督察克劳福德

关于随附的1940年4月12日英国驻沪总领事馆护照与注册办公室的来信，该信查询53岁的英籍人士、前上海水上警察雇员威廉·查尔斯·史密斯的下落，经查，此人与一名中国舞女同居于愚园路1376弄36号的后楼房间。史密斯每晚11点与该名舞女一同离开住所，并于次日凌晨4点或5点返回。据称他与西区赌窟有某种关联，但具体身份不明。考克斯先生信中提到的维维安·勒努瓦（Vivian Lenoise）先生无法提供有关史密斯下落的任何有用信息，且找到他颇费周折，因此导致提交本报告有所延误。

副督察长

助理总监（特别股）。

PASSPORT & REGISTRATION OFFICE,
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259,
SHANGHAI.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 12th April, 1938. B. D. 7988）

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I should be grateful if you would let me know
whether a certain William Charles Smith, a British subject,
aged 53, has returned to Shanghai.

He was originally a "River Constable" and gave
his address c/o Shanghai River Police, but the last address I
can trace is in 1935 Lane 166, 47 East Kashing Road.

He has two sons, John Rich aged 14 and Robert
aged 15 both of whom are being kept by charity, and I have been
informed that the father has returned to Shanghai and is living
with a Chinese woman address unknown. My informant states that
another British subject, Mr. Vivian Lenoise, living at 681,
Szechuen Road and clerk of works, Shanghai Waterworks, may
possibly be able to assist.

Again many thanks.

Yours sincerely,
（签名：Cox）

R.W. Yorke, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（手写批注：11/4 R.W.Y. 51 / 12 / ...）

护照与注册办公室，
英国驻沪总领事馆，
邮政信箱 259，
上海。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1938年4月12日。B. D. 7988）

亲爱的约克先生：

如蒙告知一位名为威廉·查尔斯·史密斯的英籍人士（53岁）是否已返回上海，我将不胜感激。

他原为“水上巡捕”，地址留的是上海水上警察局转交，但我能查到的最后一个地址是1935年的嘉善路东段47号166弄。

他有两个儿子，约翰·里奇（John Rich），14岁，和罗伯特（Robert），15岁，均由慈善机构抚养。我获悉其父已返回上海，并与一名住址不明的中国女子同居。我的线人称，另一位居住在四川路681号、担任上海自来水厂监工的英籍人士维维安·勒努瓦先生，或许能提供协助。

再次多谢。

此致
敬礼，
（签名：考克斯）

R.W. 约克先生，
副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（手写批注：4月11日 R.W.Y. 51 / 12 / ...）
